title: 交通規制のお知らせ – 東京マラソン2026（2026-11-07 复核：原页已跳转官网首页，不可再访问）
claims: The course and nearby roads are closed to vehicles for long periods on race day.
Pedestrians, bicycles and e-scooters may not cross the course; use footbridges or subway entrances instead.
Drivers must follow police and staff instructions for detours.
Some Metropolitan Expressway entrances and exits are regulated.
Drone flights over the course and venue without permission are prohibited under aviation law.
Ward-by-ward traffic-control maps were updated on 13 January 2026.
The site provides a separate page for shuttle buses serving the Akihabara and Ueno areas.
